# Field reference

80 fields, generated from the snapshot schema and the helper
function registry. This is the same list the field panel in the rule editor serves,
so anything here can be used in a condition.

Fields marked **qualified** take an argument -- the name of one of your configured
storage paths -- because the value depends on which disk you mean.

## Operators by field type

| Field type | Operators |
| --- | --- |
| `bool` | `is_true`, `is_false` |
| `list` | `contains`, `not_contains`, `in_list`, `not_in_list` |
| `number` | `eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in_list`, `is_null`, `is_not_null` |
| `string` | `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`, `matches`, `not_matches`, `in_list`, `not_in_list`, `is_null`, `is_not_null` |

## Helper functions

Available in advanced (raw SQL) mode. The visual builder prefers the precomputed
columns above, because a function call forces SQLite to evaluate row by row.

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `days_since` | days_since(epoch) -> days between an epoch timestamp and now |
| `size_gb` | size_gb(bytes) -> a byte count as gigabytes |
| `regex_match` | regex_match(text, pattern) -> 1 if the pattern matches (case-insensitive) |
| `path_matches` | path_matches(a, b) -> 1 if either path contains the other |
| `contains_token` | contains_token(list, token) -> 1 if a comma-wrapped list holds the token |
